decisions.inventory: 426 explicit original-product cards across 12 complete collector families: 130 base, 130 Essential Credentials, 29 prospect autographs, 44 jerseys, 42 jersey autographs, 30 Wall of Fame, ten retail E-Xtra Innings, three E-X Jeter issues, six E-X Season Pass exchange cards, two physical checklists.
decisions.originalVsUpdate: TCDB separates the original 130-card plastic-stock E-X issue (1455) from the ten paper-stock /499 #131–140 update cards (324240) distributed in 2001 Fleer Platinum Rookie Collection. Independent BCP lists combined 140; all 140 identities/RCs are audited, but the ten Platinum-issued cards including Albert Pujols are excluded from original E-X packs. This is an issue boundary, not an odds-driven split.
decisions.rookies: Exactly four true original-issue base RCs: 105 Ichiro Suzuki, 109 Esix Snead, 115 Elpidio Guzman, 117 Winston Abreu; agree across base, separate rookie index and BCP. RC* in BCP means a player did not reach MLB; the catalogue still recognizes Guzman RC. No inferred RC suffix on parallel/autograph/jersey cards.
decisions.sharedSerialPools: Prospect serial denominations are 1999/2499/2999, shared between signed and unsigned portions except Ichiro. Preserve serial denominator AND published signed/unsigned allocation as different attributes. For all 29 pairs, allocations sum to serial denominator and match independent BCP autograph quantities, including Brian Cole 2000 signed + 999 unsigned. Do not mislabel Hart as physically /250 or /1749.
decisions.correctedSourceErrors: Card backs directly confirm #109 Esix Snead /1999, #121 Jason Tyner /2999 and #129 Nate Rolison /2999; BCP incorrectly lists /2499 for each. Independent dedicated Jeter program and original scans confirm E-X Monumental /1996 and auto /96; generic product summary 2000/100 is wrong for this brand. Physical checklist B lists 122–130 plus inserts; source catalogue label 122–140 is corrected from reviewed front/back scans.
decisions.pendingPrintRun: Behind the Numbers Rollie Fingers autograph: TCDB /34 vs BCP /24. No actual signed card serial scan located. Roster/team is catalogued, but run unresolved and clearly flagged in CSV. Keep product blocked from release; do not silently assert either conflicting run as verified.
decisions.familyIntegrity: Base remains 130 and Essential Credentials remains 130; range-specific scarcity stays in subset and metadata. Now/Future ranges /299 and /29 are not separate completion lists. VCS uniform selection flattens prospect scarcity and serial-quantity differences.
decisions.productMembership: Jeter shared program: include only E-X #2 MM /1996, unnumbered autograph /96, Base Inks published 500. Season Pass shared 30-name matrix: include six E-X subjects only. No other-brand Jeter cards or Season Pass subjects. No unsupported standalone hologram, bat or additional parallel family.
decisions.namesTeams: Clean canonical subjects; four RC suffixes only. All 130 base and 29 prospect autograph number/name/team tuples independently match supplementary tables. Full parallel agrees with base. Insert team checks allow historically depicted affiliations: jersey Grace Chicago Cubs and Grieve Oakland vs base Arizona/Tampa Bay. Retired jerseys use card franchises, not last team or uniform-year guesses.
decisions.numbering: Retain printed 1XI–10XI and 2 MM. Unnumbered player cards get stable NNO-NAME-SLUG VCS keys; physical checklists NNO-A/B. These are local IDs, not fictitious printed numbers. MEM/AU/SN/PR/RDM and long source annotations belong in variant/subset, not player.
decisions.packOdds: Hobby default 24 packs x five cards, verified original box plus product and retailer sources. Retail three cards per pack, eight-pack blaster (7 plus bonus) is distinct. Wall of Fame 1:24 and Behind Numbers jerseys 1:33 stored; all unverified denominators null. E-Xtra Innings retail 1:20 remains null in Hobby model. Box averages do not justify invented autograph odds. Odds only at ProductSet level.
decisions.redemptions: Season Pass physical expired exchange cards included; no active entitlement simulated. A PR1 catalogue note does not prove a printed serial 1/1. Jeter Base Inks 500 is published production, not an invented printed serial denominator.
decisions.release: Unreleased draft for pricing and image harvesting; release blocked pending Rollie Fingers run, unknown odds, pack QA, images and prices. No production database access or deployment.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Original-product 130-card plastic-stock base checklist. #101–130 Rookies/Prospects share serial pools with separate autographed portions (except Ichiro). Preserve full collector family and flatten historical scarcity. Paper-stock #131–140 issued in Fleer Platinum, not original E-X packs, are audited as exclusions.

productSets.name: Essential Credentials
productSets.notes: Full original 130-card parallel: Essential Credentials Now #1–100 /299; Future #101–130 /29. One collector family with subset metadata; no verified denominator, odds null.

productSets.name: Autographed Rookies/Prospects
productSets.notes: 29 signed prospect portions, all #101–130 except Ichiro #105. Serial denominators match base pools; published signed quantities differ from denominators. No inserted Ichiro autograph invented. Odds unknown.

productSets.name: Behind the Numbers Game Jersey
productSets.notes: 44 game-used jersey subjects; Hobby 1:33 according to product checklist and retailer. Some cards depict earlier franchises (e.g. Mark Grace Chicago Cubs).

productSets.name: Behind the Numbers Game Jersey Autograph
productSets.notes: 42 signed jersey subjects; Willie Mays and Ted Williams are unsigned-only. Hand-numbered to listed quantities. Rollie Fingers source /34 disagrees with BCP /24 and remains flagged pending scan verification. Odds unknown.

productSets.name: Wall of Fame
productSets.notes: 30 subjects with pieces of Milwaukee County Stadium outfield wall; not jerseys or bats. Hobby 1:24.

productSets.name: E-Xtra Innings
productSets.notes: Ten-card numbered retail-exclusive insert checklist, historically 1:20 retail. Hobby default odds null; retained for pricing/images, not injected into Hobby packs.

productSets.name: Derek Jeter Monumental Moments
productSets.notes: Only E-X #2 MM /1996 from shared five-brand promotion; do not use generic product summary 2000.

productSets.name: Derek Jeter Monumental Moments Autographed
productSets.notes: Only E-X unnumbered /96 autograph from shared promotion; do not use generic product summary 100. Odds unknown.

productSets.name: Derek Jeter Base Inks
productSets.notes: E-X-only unnumbered Jeter autograph with piece of game-used base; published quantity 500. No invented printed /500 serial number. Odds unknown.

productSets.name: Fleer Season Pass
productSets.notes: Six E-X-assigned unnumbered redemption subjects from independent cross-brand matrix. Published one copy each; historical exchange expired December 1, 2001. Import physical collector cards only; no working redemption entitlement. Odds unknown.

productSets.name: Checklists
productSets.notes: Two physical unnumbered cards: 1–121 and 122–130 plus inserts. Both sides reviewed; source catalogue label 122–140 is incorrect and corrected from scans in the CSV, with raw label retained in provenance. Local NNO-A/B are VCS IDs, not printed numbers; teams intentionally blank. Exact odds unknown.
